# IWhitelistEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/Whitelist/IWhitelistEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IWhitelistEvents

Legacy event surface inherited by `IWhitelist`. Maintained for ABI compatibility; the
authoritative whitelist mutation event is emitted by the central access manager
(`IProtocolAccessManagerV2.WhitelistStatusUpdated(context, account, isWhitelisted)`) since the
inheriting `Whitelist` helper delegates all state to that contract.


## Events
### WhitelistStatusUpdated
Account-scoped whitelist status change. Retained for ABI compatibility; not emitted
by the `Whitelist` helper. Listen for the access-manager event for live updates.


```solidity
event WhitelistStatusUpdated(address indexed account, bool allowed);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account whose whitelist status changed|
|`allowed`|`bool`|The new whitelist status for the account|
